answer: The main risk when decision-makers rely on AI tools for complex problems without understanding their limitations is the potential for costly misuse errors. This reliance can lead to critical decisions being made without a full grasp of the capabilities and weaknesses of the AI tools, resulting in significant and unintended consequences. The lack of awareness about the performance limitations of these tools can foster misplaced trust and weaken oversight, which can exacerbate the risks associated with their misuse.
